description: The portfolio's configuration, extended by name rather than copied — see `github>youndie/sborka`, whose own description makes the argument: ten repositories had written the same file, and the five that had not are where the defects were. This replaces Renovate's onboarding `config:recommended`, which is a reasonable default for a repository with no portfolio behind it and not for one whose whole point is taking the portfolio's conventions.

THE HARNESS MERGES ITSELF, AND ITS PRECONDITION WAS RE-CHECKED ON 2026-11-25 RATHER THAN CARRIED OVER. `github>youndie/sborka:automerge-harness` is only safe where a pull request actually runs the build. When this file was written it did not — `check.yaml` ran the documentation gate and no Gradle at all, and that was the reason the preset was left out. B-06 has since added the `build` job (`make build`) to the same workflow, on every `pull_request`, and no workflow here runs only on a tag, so a harness bump that broke the build turns its own pull request red before Renovate could merge it. Extended second, and second is not cosmetic: package rules concatenate in the order the presets are named, and the harness rule has to land after the base preset's `a major of anything that ships gets a human`.

Nothing repository-specific is added, and that is the preset's own rule rather than laziness: what keel needs beyond it will be found by the preset failing to cover something. The two candidates one would guess are already covered — `kotlin` and `kotlinx` each move as one release train and the base preset groups both.
